soak-5.note: M11b soak-5, 60 min, valid (connected and visible every minute, app alive at the end), Profile build of e72ec28 (M11b merged with main e5e849a), run 2026-11-11 with a 1-minute load of 1.9-2.5, test cluster only, with -WHPerfFirstMate YES: a replayed 50-turn First Mate conversation over each 5-minute cycle (streamed through the real session, view, toolbox and encrypted store; no network, in-memory key). PASS: growth 12.5 MB (budget 15), leaks 0, threads +1, slope 11.9 MB/h. NOT MET: footprintMB 297 (budget 200) and fdsOverBaseline 9 (budget 8). The peak breach is not First Mate's: the control run on the same build without the replay peaks at 267 MB (see soak-5-control), the graphics transient of the overlapping floating windows recorded in M4a (233 MB there). First Mate adds about 30 MB to the peak, 7 MB to growth and about 5.7 points of average CPU while it streams (11.5 % vs 5.8 %; the replay streams roughly 60 % of the time at about 28 deltas/s, published to the view at <= 4/s). An earlier run on the pre-merge build (e18ce91 + M11b, before the transcript-row change) measured peak 279 MB, growth 14.6 MB, fds +5, CPU 11.3 %.
